mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_log(ingredient_id, ingredient_name, category_name, supplier_name, old_price, new_price, change_pct, change_type, created_at) VALUES(#{ingredientId}, #{ingredientName}, #{categoryName}, #{supplierName}, #{oldPrice}, #{newPrice}, #{changePct}, #{changeType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT ingredient_name AS name, old_price AS oldPrice, new_price AS newPrice, change_pct AS changePct, change_type AS changeType, created_at AS time FROM price_log WHERE ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN change_type='修改' AND change_pct > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upCount, SUM(CASE WHEN change_type='修改' AND change_pct < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downCount, AVG(CASE WHEN change_type='修改' AND change_pct > 0 THEN change_pct END) AS avgUp FROM price_log
